items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: And you know my trumpet mate was Conrad Gozzo. And we were kids together, teenagers, and sitting and playing with him all the time... I roomed with Conrad for two and a half years. We left Red Norvo’s band to go with Claude Thornhill’s band. We left together.

ctx.x: And you know my trumpet mate was Conrad Gozzo. And we were kids together, teenagers, and sitting and playing with him all the time, what more could you ask for? © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
Yeah. There’s actually a little quote from this book Inside the Big Bands by a fellow Simon—
